The '''Book of Vengeance''' is a usable [[:Category:Weapons|Weapon]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Dropped when a [[Primitive Reeker]] named "''Ricardo''" is killed.

== ''Usage'' ==
The book allows the user to execute various attacks depending on the input, but seems to still be a WIP.
*Right-clicking an enemy will summon a line of purple particles at the targeted enemy. After a delay, the player will go flying at the enemy, making contact and bouncing off before performing the second slam, which always summons lightning. If the player gets stuck behind a block as this is happening, the slams will be performed on the enemy regardless of contact. This inflicts [[Bleeding|Bleeding I]], [[Debar|Debar I]], and [[Concussive Smoke Trail]] for five seconds.
*Right-clicking while sneaking knocks back all entities that are close to the player.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The Book of Vengeance is a reference to the book of the same name from Limbus Company.
